detail.title: Predictive Processing in Auditory Perception: Synthesis of ASAP and Interoceptive Inference
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes the ASAP hypothesis and active interoceptive inference frameworks to model musical experience as a dynamic, error-correcting process. We examine how musical beat perception (ASAP) and emotion-induction function as mechanisms for minimizing prediction error in temporal auditory sequences.

detail.title: Predictive Processing and Auditory Simulation
detail.summary: Exploration of how musical structure leverages predictive processing frameworks, specifically the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) and interoceptive inference.
detail.reason: Synthesis of key predictive processing literature for music fulfills the project requirement for a notebook.
